associations.rationale: The formal type supplies a Real → AlgEquiv Real A A family under a derivation hypothesis, but it does not display NormedSpace.exp or identify the returned automorphisms with exp(tD).
The displayed equality exp((s+t)D) = exp(sD) * exp(tD) directly states the one-parameter composition law.
The formal type states exp(0D) = 1, supplying the identity special case that supports the one-parameter-group claim.
